mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contracting housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of industrial contraction periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, persistent inflation signals potential premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), cheap credit stimulates economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
